messages:
sara_sales: Quick update from Thornton POC - we ran a 30m ramp to 200 qps steady. Need help summarizing results for AE and answering SSO/KMS questions. @matt_se @ana_sre

matt_se: Nice. Can you drop raw numbers? throughput, p95, error rate, model used, quant config?

sara_sales: Yep: model: redwood/gpt-4-lite-v0 (quant-8), 200 qps sustained, avg latency 85ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.6% (mostly 429s during warmup), tokens/s ~14k, KV cache enabled. test script: `hey load --qps 200 --dur 1800 --seq 1024`

ana_sre: Thanks. 210ms p95 at 200 qps on dedicated pool is solid. 429 during warmup suggests concurrency burst — recommend pre-warm and increase burst capacity. Can you share pod logs for a 429? also region?

sara_sales: Region: us-west-2 dedicated. Pod log snippet: ```2026-03-10T10:12:03Z WARN throttle: max_inflight=128 req=192 -> 429```

matt_se: Plan for AE: recommend adding autoscale burst + KV prefix caching for repeated prefixes. Also offer quant-4 suggestion if they accept slight quality drop for ~30% cost reduction.

li_security: Thornton asked re: SSO for Console and KMS/HSM for model keys. Short answers: Console supports SSO via SAML/OIDC (Okta, Azure). KMS: we integrate with AWS KMS and support customer-managed keys; HSM option available on Private deployments only. I'll paste the detail doc after.

sara_sales: Perfect. Also pricing ask: they want committed per-month throughput price estimate for 200 qps steady for 30d. Anyone have calc?

matt_se: Rough calc: 200 qps * 86,400s/day = 17,280,000 requests/day. tokens/request ~75 -> tokens/day ~1.296B. At $0.003 per 1k tokens -> ~$3,888/day -> ~$116k/month. With dedicated reserved capacity discounts (approx 50-60%) -> ballpark ~$46k–58k/mo. Super rough, finance to confirm.

finance-bot: Pricing estimate logged to deal/Ticket #2324. Please flag if you need a formal quote.

ana_sre: :thumbsup: For the runbook, I'll add a prewarm job and suggested autoscale settings (min_replicas=4, burst_limit=2x). Also recommend steady-state KV cache hits >70% to hit the numbers. Share whether they need multi-AZ failover.

sara_sales: They do want multi-AZ failover and SOC2 artifacts. @li_security can you send the checklist and SOC2 cert?

li_security: On it. Will send SOC2 PDF, SAML setup guide, and KMS integration playbook via email in ~30m and add to deal folder.

sara_sales: Thanks team — I'll compile this into the AE note and send to Thornton. Will close thread after doc is uploaded to the shared drive.
